pick.name: Claude API (Anthropic)
pick.what: Anthropic Messages API: tool use, structured outputs, computer use, batch, Agent SDK; also resold via Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud
pick.why: Top-tier agentic/coding quality at mid-range prices (Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10 per MTok, Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50, Opus 5.5 $4/$20, Batch -50%); first-party typed SDKs; enterprise clouds as exit routes
pick.free_limits: No free tier; new API accounts receive a small amount of free credits to test. Pay-as-you-go (postpaid). Prices per MTok in/out: Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50 for prompts up to 100K tokens ($0.50/$2.50 above 100K), Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10, Opus 5.5 $4/$20, Opus 5 $5/$25, Fable 5.1 $10/$50. Batch API -50%.
pick.maintained: Pricing page lists Fable 5.1, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 (seen 2026-10-28); @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.3.0 and anthropic (PyPI) 2.3.0 on 2026-10-23

best_free.name: Gemini API free tier (Google AI Studio)
best_free.what: Free-of-charge Gemini Flash/Flash-Lite/2.5 Pro, Gemma 4 and Gemini Embedding 2 via API key
best_free.why: Widest free model set (Flash, Flash-Lite, Gemma, embeddings) with multimodal; free-tier content is used to improve Google products, so prototyping only
best_free.free_limits: Free of charge on Gemini 3.8/3.6 Flash, Flash-Lite, 2.5 Pro/Flash, Live/TTS models and Gemma 4; Gemini 4 Argon and 3.1 Pro are paid-only. Exact RPM/RPD shown only in AI Studio. Free-tier ('Unpaid Services') content is used to improve Google products and may be read by human reviewers; paid tier is not.
best_free.commercial_ok: yes, with limits: users must be 18+; free tier may not be used for API clients serving users in the EEA, Switzerland or UK (paid only there); never send personal or confidential data

alts.name: OpenAI API
alts.what: GPT-6 family API with a wide small-model range
alts.why: Equal-tier alternative: gpt-6.1-sol $2/$10, gpt-6.1-terra $1/$5, gpt-6-luna $0.10/$0.50 per MTok; best ecosystem and realtime/voice
alts.free_limits: No free tier on pricing page; regional data-residency endpoints carry a 10% uplift
alts.install: npm i openai  |  pip install openai

alts.name: Gemini API (paid tier)
alts.what: Google Gemini API; paid tier content is not used to improve Google products
alts.why: Cheapest strong long-context/multimodal option: Gemini 3.8 Flash $0.75/$3.75 (rising to $1.50/$7.50 on 2027-01-01); Gemini 4 Argon $2/$10 through 2026-11-30 then $4/$20
alts.free_limits: Paid tier required for Gemini 4 Argon and 3.1 Pro; promotional prices end on dates shown

candidates.verdict: Pick: best agent/coding quality per dollar, mature SDKs, BAA path

candidates.verdict: Runner-up; cheapest long context, free tier (trains on data)

candidates.verdict: Cheap open-weight APIs; data-jurisdiction review needed; not verified

decision: Claude API is the pick on quality and reliability for agent and coding workloads, with OpenAI and Gemini within a close margin on price; the site recommends building behind a thin provider-neutral layer so the choice stays reversible. Gemini free tier is the best free sandbox but is trained on, so never send customer data. Flip to OpenAI for voice/realtime-first products or to Gemini Flash when cost per call dominates.
details: Prices are per million tokens and change often. Free tiers: Gemini trains on free-tier content and humans may review it (opened); OpenRouter stores no prompts by default (opened).

region_notes.EU: Gemini API terms allow only Paid Services when making API clients available to users in the EEA or Switzerland, so the free tier is a developer sandbox only there.
region_notes.India: Provider billing is USD by card; confirm local tax invoicing and data-protection (DPDP) obligations before processing customer data.
region_notes.UK: Same as EU: only Paid Services may back API clients offered to UK users.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
